description: Defines the CrcCordState class, a copy-on-write class managing chunked CRC32C data for efficient substring operations within the Abseil library.

classes.name: CrcCordState
classes.description: Manages copy-on-write CRC32C chunked data for efficient string operations.

methods.name: Checksum
methods.description: Returns the CRC32C checksum of the entire Cord.

methods.name: IsNormalized
methods.description: Checks if the CRC cache is normalized (no removed prefix).

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes the CRC cache by subtracting any removed prefix.

methods.name: NumChunks
methods.description: Returns the number of cached CRC chunks.

methods.name: NormalizedPrefixCrcAtNthChunk
methods.description: Returns the (length, crc) of the nth cached chunk.

methods.name: Poison
methods.description: Poisons all chunks to likely produce an incorrect checksum.
